\section*{Closed-set identification}
\label{sec:supp-closed-set}

Every feature set at every K, per cell, from the closed-set result files (deviation D8: every trial of S12 left out). Accuracy is the maximum over the set and the sets derivable from it, with its source and its Wilson interval; Raw is the accuracy of the set alone with its Wilson interval; the speed and scenario columns give the raw accuracy, descriptively and without an interval. The feature sets that keep time are estimates only (section 6.8 of the registration).
